parser_requirements: Python 3.10+; compile parser additionally uses frozen sibling pure capture/runtime contracts and NumPy to read private saved arrays

Compilation parser sibling defaults are ../runtime/v49_quantized_pair_runtime_contracts.py and ../capture/v49_capture_contracts.py; --runtime-contracts/--capture-contracts allow explicit locations, same exact SHA checks
CLI SHA values must come from independently pinned receipts; stdout hashes calculated from arbitrary untrusted files are not evidence
Output paths must not exist; complete parser outputs stay private, slim JSON summaries are the public evidence
Scripts only read saved artifacts; no board connection, toolchain or inference is executed
